limits: Software/host evidence is not physical stopping-distance or ranging-accuracy acceptance.
Unknown/invalid distance does not newly block forward; invalid data never clears an existing block.
Local warning uses device volume; physical audio, cloud speech concurrency and actuator response need field checks.
No automatic restart, reverse, turn or navigation.
Telemetry included intermittent echo_high. Invalid samples cannot establish clearance; the sensor may change between status reads.
Observed warning dispatch is not an acoustic/heard-speech check. No physical moving-stop trial was performed.
